evidence.source: Contract 204 applied to Development on 18 August 2026 through the ADR 0024 fast lane, run 32196292139, from exact main e896178e9de63c738b5ed947605bfd482cd13a76. Development holds no AI Lab data - 0 bets, 0 predictions, 0 api_usage - because the lab runs against Production, so these are structural answers rather than answers over rows.
